subject: POC: model selection & success criteria - FinTechCo trial
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC: model selection & success criteria - FinTechCo trial

Hi Emma / Raj —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC started this week:

1) Success criteria (please confirm):
   - Response accuracy for end-user prompts: >= 85% correct / relevant on our 120-sample test set
   - Latency: 95th percentile generation <= 450ms for short prompts (<=128 tokens)
   - Multilingual coverage: Spanish support for customer-facing responses with <=5% quality delta vs English
   - Safety/regulatory: PII redaction pass on our sample dataset (we'll share checklist)

2) Proposed evaluation plan and timeline:
   - Shared artifacts: I attached a one-sheet "POC-success-criteria.xlsx" with the test cases and scoring rubric.
   - Week 0 (this week): access + baseline run (1-2 days)
   - Week 1: model tuning + batch evals (3 days)
   - Week 2: full user-sim load tests + final review

3) Model selection (initial recommendation):
   - Primary trial model: Llama-2-13b-chat (quantized 4-bit) - best balance of quality and cost for English + Spanish when using Redwood quantization profiles.
   - Fallback model: Llama-2-7b-chat - used for burst capacity and as a lower-cost option if latency spikes.
   - Alternative (if hallucination needs are stricter): Falcon-40B-Instruct (hosted variant) - higher quality but more expensive; we can include as an optional comparison.

4) Ownership & contacts:
   - Redwood AE (owner): Aditya Rao
   - SE (technical lead): Marissa Cole (I've cc'd her) - will own trial setup, prompts, and eval harness.

Next steps: Please confirm the success criteria or propose edits, and confirm whether you want Falcon included in the comparison. Once we have agreement I'll send a short MPA + access instructions and Marissa will schedule the baseline run.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: POC: model selection & success criteria - FinTechCo trial

Hi Emma —

Quick technical note from the SE side on the model choices and what we'll need to run the baseline:

- Llama-2-13b-chat (recommended): quantize to 4-bit with Redwood’s QC profile; we expect ~15-25% cost savings vs FP16 with similar output quality. Works well out-of-the-box for Spanish given prompt engineering.
- Llama-2-7b-chat (fallback): use for burst and as an A/B to measure quality delta. Expect ~1.2x faster latency.
- Falcon-40B-Instruct (optional comparison): stronger on instruction-following in English; Spanish performance is uneven unless we do a short finetune or prompt-conditioning.

Data & infra requests for baseline run:
- A sample of 120 user prompts (mix of English/Spanish) - preferably in CSV with columns: id, prompt, expected_response (optional)
- Access window: 48 hours of sandbox capacity (we'll coordinate instance sizing)
- If you have any IP/PII constraints let us know; default PII redaction will be enabled during baseline runs.

I’ve attached a model-selection matrix CSV and the POC setup guide. I’ll prepare a prompt suite for the Spanish samples and share the eval harness repo link after you confirm.

—Marissa
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

- Timeline: target kickoff next Tuesday (2026-09-01) and final review two weeks after. That works for our stakeholders.

- Security: we need data retention to be 30 days for the trial and a SOC2 evidence packet (if available) - Raj will coordinate on the compliance asks.
